cases.case: new STABLE control-only function, narrow ETA grant and independent privilege-pin change
zero-accepted receipts and expired-but-still-stored receipts are inventory members
ETA-only contributor is included and intervals remain covered by the unchanged receipt FK
current/expired temporary fences and permanent-only fences are included without expiry guessing
only the caller candidate subset is returned; unrelated/ledger/unknown hashes do not leak
matched hashes are distinct/sorted across source overlap and the 4096-candidate bound is usable
null/duplicate/invalid/oversized candidates reject with 22023, never normalization or truncation
runtime/executor/PUBLIC access and non-read-only control calls fail closed
actual store binding is returned; missing binding is unavailable and is never adopted
read-only function leaves every row unchanged and takes no write/advisory/tuple locks or XID
RLS drift is unavailable rather than a false empty inventory
actual owner/hash index prefixes remain usable with input char64 casts and no new day column

interpretation: Twelve new actual SQL006 groups. Candidate membership does not determine contributor days, account ownership, complete key history, Root authority or erasure completion.
